body: {"better": "A", "reason": "Card A gives one clear reason to enjoy (మీరు కాసేపు హాయిగా ఉండొచ్చు) and explicitly states 'కారులో వెళ్తాము' as a separate clear instruction for how to get there. Card B's 'పార్కులో ప్రశాంతంగా ఉంటుంది' is more about the place than why he'd enjoy it, and buries the car information grammatically inside the destination phrase rather than stating the travel mode clearly."}
